fixer.title: Batch stored shell output lookups when restoring Agent Host chats

introducer.title: Retain full Codex shell output across chat reloads

cases.mechanism: The base retained-output restore loop awaited getTerminalOutputSize for every replayed command. The database sequences each lookup and executes an individual SQLite SELECT, so full history reads and changed-history refreshes paid one round trip per command.
cases.symptom: Opening a Codex thread with many commands, or refreshing a changed history containing many commands, is blocked on serialized database latency proportional to the command count.
cases.fixedBehavior: The changed code sends all replayed command IDs through one getTerminalOutputSizes query and checks the resulting map locally. Reads of full output remain limited to stored calls whose replayed output needs replacement, as before.
cases.evidence: Codex _getChatMessages and _refreshChatHistory both await _restoreRetainedCommandOutputs. Deleted base line 7325 performed one awaited size lookup per command; RIGHT line 7325 performs one batched query outside the loop. The added 503-command test asserts one batch, no single calls, and only one unchanged full-content read.
